name: Cabaclub Time
source:
Cabaret - a battlefield of love, where women compete to get the most attention and become #1 in hopes that they might someday meet a prince and have a happy marriage.

In addition, the cabaret club "Illusion" is known for its conscientious services and good price. The clientele includes politicians, wealthy people, CEOs, celebrities, top-tier athletes, etc.

Main character works as a clerk at a cabaret. One day most popular hostess is unavailable, and protagonist is asked by the manager to fill in. Protagonist reluctantly agrees, but little by little starts to enjoy her position. However, she starts to feel rivalry for the chair of №1 hostess very soon.

[derived from archived website: https://web.archive.org/web/20030418122343/http://www.dice-soft.co.jp/Pirka/soft/illusion/story.htm]
